Marta: Hey team — urgent policy Q. I had to get a PCR test in Singapore (S$120) because the country requires a negative PCR within 48h for conference entry and my return airline also required it. Can I expense the test and the cab to the clinic?
Asha (People Ops): Sorry for the rush — short answer: yes, if the test is required by the destination country, airline, or for an approved work event, we reimburse the cost + reasonable transport.
Marta: What docs do you need? I have the receipt from the clinic and the PDF test result with my name, and the conference registration email that says PCR required.
Asha (People Ops): Perfect. Upload all of those to Expensify and use category = "Travel Health / Mandatory Testing". Required attachments: itemized clinic receipt, the electronic test result showing name/date/type of test, and supporting evidence that it was required (airline email, border guidance, or event registration). Add a one-line note: "PCR required for entry to conference + airline".
Chris (Manager): I can confirm Marta's trip was company-approved and the conference required testing. Approving reimbursement in comments.
Marta: Thanks — is there any cap or timeline? My card posted 3 days after the test — Expensify shows the charge date as test date.
Asha (People Ops): No special cap for mandatory tests; we reimburse actuals for required tests. Use the test date as the expense date. If the test was voluntary (e.g., convenience or peace of mind) it is not reimbursable unless pre-approved. Rapid antigen self-tests are reimbursable only if required by policy or client; otherwise not.
Marta: And if insurance covers part of it?
Asha (People Ops): If your travel/health insurance reimburses you, attach their confirmation and we'll adjust — we do not double-reimburse. If the insurer reimburses later, update the expense so Finance can reconcile.
Health-Bot: Reminder: See travel health guidance 1 https://intranet.redwood.com/travel-health -> "Testing & vaccines". Expense tool: Expensify.
Marta: Uploaded clinic_receipt.pdf + pcr_result.pdf + conf_email.png and added the note. Pinged Chris for approval.
Asha (People Ops): Got it  once Chris signs off Finance will process as "Travel Health" and fast-track COVID/testing claims. If anything's missing we'll reach out. Closing when paid. :white_check_mark:
